description: QR codes, short links, landing pages and forms from your agent: a local bridge to the hosted Hovercode MCP service that creates and manages QR codes (single, bulk and PDF), short links, block-built landing pages, forms and their responses, folders, tags and templates, and reads scan and link analytics in your Hovercode workspace. One bin serves a small CLI and a stdio MCP server.
name: @reneturcios/qrcanvas
